action.content: Write a persuasive email to a teenager who lives in Aberdeen, Scotland. The main point is to encourage them to volunteer at a local soup kitchen. At least 5 words in the output should be in all caps.
action.label: context

action.content:
Subject: Make a REAL difference in Aberdeen today!

Hi there,

I know life in Aberdeen can get busy with school, friends, and the ever-changing weather, but I want to challenge you to do something that will change your perspective FOREVER. Have you ever thought about volunteering at a local soup kitchen right here in our city?

It might seem like a small act, but the impact is MASSIVE. Imagine walking into a warm space where people are struggling, and you are the one bringing them a hot meal and a friendly smile. You aren't just serving food; you are building COMMUNITY. In a city as vibrant as ours, we have a responsibility to look out for one another, especially when the winds are howling outside.

This isn't just about charity; it's about connection. You will meet people from all walks of life and hear stories that will stay with you. It is a chance to step out of your comfort zone and see the world through different eyes. The experience will be UNFORGETTABLE and will teach you more than any textbook ever could.

Don't wait for the perfect moment; create it NOW. Your time and energy are valuable, and they are needed HERE. Let's come together to make Aberdeen a warmer, kinder place for everyone.

Take the first step today.

Cheers,

A Friend
